purpose: Describe observable MCP flow nodes, CLIPS decisions, continuation gates, and violation evidence.

violation_classes.manual_content_processing_forbidden: The model read or transformed file bodies in chat for a flow that must use atomic tools.
violation_classes.non_terminal_completion_claim: The model claimed completion while terminal/completion/final/verification gates were not all true.
violation_classes.required_tool_arguments_ignored: A tool result provided required_tool_arguments_json but the next tool call did not use it.
violation_classes.directory_manifest_not_terminal: A directory listing was treated as analysis completion instead of an intermediate manifest.
violation_classes.text_range_delete_incomplete: A bounded deletion step returned has_more=true but the loop stopped.
violation_classes.context_growth_unbounded: The flow brought large file content into the chat context instead of keeping state in MCP artifacts.
